I computed the closure: (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1}) is the 3-cycle (1 2)(2 3), its cube is the identity permutation, so the closure has 3 components = the Borromean rings. Reported, not resolved: n=4 may denote a different 4-strand construction, but nothing in the table or the cited blocks says so.
